gb_v1_f26b_inversion_impact.finding: INV-01 proved GB V1 treats f26b as NEGATIVE (7 neg vs 3 pos in leaf splits). L37 says f26b is POSITIVE for quality.
gb_v1_f26b_inversion_impact.implication: GB V1 PENALIZES long sentence rate, which L37 says is a quality DRIVER. This explains why GB is more pessimistic on texts with higher f26b.
gb_v1_f26b_inversion_impact.severity: HIGH — GB V1 scorer systematically undervalues texts that exhibit L37 causally beneficial patterns

conclusion: MIXED — GB V1 and V3 agree on general ranking but diverge on edge cases near SAGA threshold. The f26b polarity inversion in GB V1 (INV-01) is a structural flaw that biases GB against L37-compliant prose.
